relationships.subject: VX-128
relationships.evidence_quote: VX-128 is a highly potent and selective Na<sub>v</sub> 1.8 inhibitor that was being developed as a treatment for pain.

relationships.subject: VX-128
relationships.evidence_quote: After multiple dosing of up to 10 days, skin rash events were observed at all dose levels (up to 100 mg once daily [q.d.]), in five of 26 (19.2%) subjects

relationships.subject: VX-128
relationships.evidence_quote: A trend in pain tolerance were observed for cold pressor- and pressure pain, which was dose-dependent for the latter.

key_findings: Phase I VX-128 well tolerated as single doses up to 300 mg but multiple dosing caused rash and angioedema, ending the study early.
Trend toward increased cold pressor and pressure pain thresholds.
